contributions.detail: ZERO-ACTIVITY CLOSING PERIOD. Schedule A (p3) is the blank county form: every one of its 16 printed ruled lines is empty, the whole body is struck through with a single hand-drawn diagonal line running from the lower-left of the Name column to the upper-right of the Address column, and the filer wrote a 0 on the 'Subtotal for this page' line. Zero rows transcribed sum to 0.00 = the printed page subtotal 0 = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD cell (Column A line 1 = 0). The printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' line was LEFT BLANK by the filer. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 4677.47 and is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime); it carries earlier periods this final report does not itemize.

itemized.escalation_note: Two tight cell crops at 900 dpi on the 'Subtotal for this page' cells, to settle the glyph under the ZERO-GLYPH RULING before recording an empty-schedule state: pct:76,84,22,5@p3 rendered the printed label 'Subtotal for this page   $' followed by a single handwritten closed-loop ZERO, and pct:76,82,22,5@p4 rendered the same label followed by a handwritten ZERO. Both are numerals denoting zero, not bare dashes, so the schedules affirmatively state 0 rather than leaving the cell blank. No amount cell needed escalation because no amount cell is written on.
